Hunter New England Local Health District is seeking applications from suitably qualified Addiction Medicine specialists to join our established Drug and Alcohol Clinical Services (DACS) team. 

This is an exciting opportunity to provide contemporary, evidence-based, addiction medicine services across a diverse range of inpatient, outpatient, hospital consultation-liaison, telehealth and community-based settings throughout HNELHD, Mid North Coast and Northern NSW LHDs.
